object: top 5 highest-grossing films as of November 20, 2023
belief: The top 5 highest-grossing films of all time as of November 20, 2023 are: 1. Avatar ($2.92B), 2. Avengers: Endgame ($2.80B), 3. Avatar: The Way of Water ($2.33B), 4. Titanic ($2.26B), 5. Star Wars: The Force Awakens ($2.07B)

author: worker_4
belief: Titanic (1997) is the 4th highest-grossing film of all time as of November 20, 2023, directed by James Cameron

author: worker_4
belief: Star Wars: The Force Awakens (2015) is the 5th highest-grossing film of all time as of November 20, 2023, directed by J.J. Abrams
